You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository pandas-dev/pandas.

Problem Statement:
BUG: resampling empty series loses time zone from dtype
### Pandas version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/whatsnew/index.html) of pandas.

- [ ] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [main branch](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/dev/getting_started/install.html#installing-the-development-version-of-pandas) of pandas.

### Reproducible Example

```python
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'ts': [],
    'values': []
}).astype({'ts': 'datetime64[ns, Atlantic/Faroe]'})
df.resample('2MS', on='ts', closed='left', label='left', origin='start')['values'].sum().index
```

### Issue Description

this prints
```python
DatetimeIndex([], dtype='datetime64[ns]', name='ts', freq='2MS')
```

### Expected Behavior

```
DatetimeIndex([], dtype='datetime64[ns, Atlantic/Faroe]', name='ts', freq='2MS')
```

note that this works fine if the series isn't empty
```python
In [27]: df = pd.DataFrame({
    ...:     'ts': [datetime(2020, 1, 1)],
    ...:     'values': [10]
    ...: })
    ...: df['ts'] = df['ts'].dt.tz_localize('Atlantic/Faroe')
    ...: df.resample('2MS', on='ts', closed='left', label='left', origin='start')['values'].sum().index
Out[27]: DatetimeIndex(['2020-01-01 00:00:00+00:00'], dtype='datetime64[ns, Atlantic/Faroe]', name='ts', freq='2MS')
```

entries.author: teacher
entries.content: The root cause was in `BinGrouper._get_time_bins` (pandas/core/resample.py): for an empty DatetimeIndex, the empty binner/labels were built with `DatetimeIndex(data=[], freq=self.freq, name=ax.name)`, which defaults to a plain `datetime64[ns]` dtype, discarding the axis's timezone (and any non-nanosecond unit). The fix passes `dtype=ax.dtype` to the constructor so the empty result preserves the original timezone and unit. Verified with the issue's example, a non-nano-unit case, and the full `pandas/tests/resample` suite (3808 passed).
